RequireMfa.label: Multifactor authentication
RequireMfa.description: Without it, a stolen or guessed password is enough to sign in as one of them.

PhishingResistantMfa.label: Phishing-resistant authentication
PhishingResistantMfa.description: Without it, their multifactor prompt can be captured by a convincing phishing page.

RequireCompliantDevice.label: Managed device
RequireCompliantDevice.description: Without it, they can sign in from any device, including unmanaged or infected ones.

BlockLegacyAuth.label: Legacy authentication blocked
BlockLegacyAuth.description: Without it, older sign-in methods that cannot use multifactor authentication remain available to them.

SignInRisk.label: Sign-in risk response
SignInRisk.description: Without it, a sign-in that Microsoft rates as suspicious goes through without any extra check.

UserRisk.label: User risk response
UserRisk.description: Without it, an account that Microsoft rates as likely compromised keeps working until someone notices.

SessionControls.label: Session limits
SessionControls.description: Without it, a session on a shared or lost device stays valid indefinitely.

BlockCountries.label: Location restrictions
BlockCountries.description: Without it, sign-ins are accepted from any country or network.
